name: Cvent
description_en:
Cvent provides software for planning and running in-person, virtual and hybrid events. Its event-management offering spans registration, attendee experiences and onsite check-in, while other Cvent products serve venue sourcing, hospitality sales, room blocks and related tasks. Buying one event solution does not establish access to the entire vendor portfolio.

This profile focuses on the organizer workflow from a branded registration site to attendee records and onsite activity. The public pricing page asks for a quote, with selected Professional licenses and a broader Enterprise package. Integration work, onsite services and specialist products must be scoped separately.
description_zh:
Cvent 为线下、线上及混合活动提供规划与执行软件。活动管理涵盖报名、参与者体验及现场签到，其他产品处理场地寻源、酒店销售、房间预订等。购买某个活动方案不证明可以使用厂商全部产品。

本文聚焦组织者从品牌报名网站到参与者记录及现场活动的流程。公开定价要求询价，Professional 选择所需许可，Enterprise 为较广组合，集成实施、现场服务和专业产品仍需另定范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Build registration sites and personalized paths with a drag-and-drop designer.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过拖放设计器创建报名网站及个性化路径。

core_features.explanation_en: OnArrival supports check-in, badge printing and session capacity operations under its license.
core_features.explanation_zh: OnArrival 许可支持签到、徽章打印和场次容量操作。

en: Manage a paid workshop from registration through onsite check-in.
zh: 管理付费工作坊从报名到现场签到。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: List needed modules, configure one attendee registration and validate the downstream payment, CRM and check-in records.
steps.zh: 列出所需模块，配置一位参与者报名，并核对支付、CRM 与签到记录。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Custom quote by selected products, licenses, programme and services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Official pricing is quote-based. Professional licenses selected solutions and lists fifteen logins; Enterprise includes the core organizer licenses and wider administration. Specialist products, hardware/payment requirements and professional services must be confirmed in the quote. No amount or sustained-free entitlement was verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方需询价。Professional 选择所需方案，列 15 个登录；Enterprise 包含核心组织者许可及更广管理。专业产品、硬件/支付及专业服务需在报价确认，未核实金额或持续免费权益。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow one attendee from invitation to arrival
sections.title_zh: 沿一位参与者核对邀请到到场
sections.en: Cvent Registration includes site design, event templates, personalized content, form pre-population, email campaigns, reminders and payment management. For an illustrative paid workshop, configure the attendee path, ticket/session eligibility and confirmation. Then inspect the resulting attendee record and the onsite check-in path. Registration completion is not proof of physical attendance, and a badge print is not a payment reconciliation.
sections.zh: Cvent Registration 包含网站设计、活动模板、个性化内容、表单预填、邮件活动、提醒和支付管理。例如付费工作坊，应配置报名路径、票种/场次资格和确认，再检查参与者记录及现场签到。完成报名不能证明实际到场，打印徽章也不等于完成收款核对。

sections.title_en: Select the license for each part of the event
sections.title_zh: 为活动每一环节选择许可
sections.en: Professional lets buyers license the required Registration, Attendee Hub or OnArrival solution and lists fifteen user logins. Enterprise includes those licenses plus Essentials and broader administration, API, budgeting and sign-in capabilities. Attendee Hub handles mobile/virtual engagement; OnArrival covers kiosk check-in, badge printing and session operations. Passkey, Abstract Management, LeadCapture and other named products appear as further enhancements, not universal inclusions.
sections.zh: Professional 让买方选择 Registration、Attendee Hub 或 OnArrival，列 15 个用户登录。Enterprise 包含这些许可及 Essentials，并扩展管理、API、预算和登录能力。Attendee Hub 负责移动/线上互动，OnArrival 负责自助签到、徽章和场次管理。Passkey、Abstract Management、LeadCapture 等另列增强产品，不是普遍包含。

sections.title_en: Test the specific integration and payment route
sections.title_zh: 测试具体集成与支付路径
sections.en: The registration page names Salesforce, HubSpot and Marketo connections and describes dashboards and UTM tracking. These support an event-data handoff, but exact mappings, deduplication, retry and destination permissions still need verification. Payments and onsite hardware also have separate operational dependencies. Do not convert a CRM connection or a dashboard into a claim of measured revenue attribution or guaranteed ROI.
sections.zh: 报名页列 Salesforce、HubSpot、Marketo 连接，以及仪表盘和 UTM 跟踪。这些支持活动数据交接，但准确映射、去重、重试和目标权限仍需核对。支付与现场硬件也各有运行依赖，不能由 CRM 连接或仪表盘推导出已测收入归因或保证 ROI。

sections.title_en: Build a quote around the event programme
sections.title_zh: 围绕活动计划形成报价范围
sections.en: No standard public price was established. Specify event count and format, users, registrations, onsite devices/badges, virtual content, integrations and support before comparing a quote. Implementation, Event Build and 360 services are separately described. Cvent merits evaluation for managed event programmes needing connected operations; a simple RSVP may need a narrower tool. No self-hosted server or open-source license was verified, and this profile did not execute a purchase, registration or onsite workflow.
sections.zh: 本次未确定标准公开金额。比较报价前应说明活动数与形式、用户、报名、现场设备/徽章、线上内容、集成和支持。Implementation、Event Build、360 服务另列。需要连接多环节运营的活动项目可评估 Cvent，简单 RSVP 可能只需较窄工具。本次未确认自托管服务端或开源许可，也未执行购买、报名或现场流程。

research_gaps: No account, registration, payment/refund, CRM sync, badge printer, offline check-in or report was tested.
Quote amounts, license metering, hardware/payment fees, offline/recovery behavior, contract retention/residency, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
